posts.cooked:
Respected Instructors,

I have a quick question about the virtual machine environment for our upcoming graded assignments. I noticed that the default system time on the VM is set to UTC. To avoid any potential confusion or issues with the submission deadlines, which I assume are in IST, could you please clarify if we should change the VM’s timezone to Asia/Kolkata? I just want to ensure my submission timing aligns correctly with the portal’s requirements.

Thank you for your guidance.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
23f2000539:

we should change the VM’s timezone to Asia/Kolkata

You cannot change the VM’s timezone to Asia/Kolkata.

@sayan Can you check please?
So is it fine , if we leave it as it is ? It doesn’t affect our BPT assignments submission or anything ?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: No it does not affect your deadlines, your deadlines are in IST.
